gist: Archival cover: Дирекція Императорскихъ Театровъ; дело title (correspondence with the Warsaw government theatres about sending the «Ежегодникъ»), 1895-1896; RGIA stamps ф.497 оп.18 ед.хр.161. Lower title slip faint.

gist: Warsaw theatre official asks that the just-published latest Ежегодникъ with its two supplement booklets be sent to him cash-on-delivery, citing the announcement circulated by the Типографія Императорскихъ Театровъ and the review (оцѣнка) recently printed in Новое Время. Heavy resolution scrawl top left (apparently routing it to Петровъ and proposing something to the writer; mostly unread); margin note «Вып. IV».

gist: Continuation of p.3 (verso; top covered by the modern «Листъ использованія документовъ» form). He asks whether, as the first and perhaps only man in Warsaw who has bought the Ежегодникъ regularly from the very start, a poor minor official of the Theatre Administration who also serves the theatre with his pen, he might be let off payment for the 1893/4 Ежегодникъ with supplements (postage excepted).
why: reader/buyer testimony from Warsaw; request for a free copy

gist: Lower part of the same verso (overlaps p.5): repeat of the free-copy plea, closing compliments and signature «І. Гологовскій».

gist: Address slip belonging to the letter: «Мой адресъ: Іосифъ Львовичъ Гологовскій, Чиновникъ Управленія Варшав. Правит. Театровъ въ Варшавѣ, Теплая улица домъ № 14 кв. 14».
why: address only

gist: Flattered by the attention shown him through Петровъ by Владиміръ Петровичъ, he has out of gratitude taken up distributing the «Ежегодникъ Императорскихъ Театровъ» among Varsovians; says its careful production delights everyone who sees it. Date at top right not legible in the photo.
why: Warsaw commission agent reports to Петровъ; reception of the edition

gist: Same page as p.8 (overlap, lower portion; salutation and first paragraph). Edge of another leaf visible at the bottom.
why: overlap of p.8

gist: Continuation: readers unanimously say that even abroad they have not met an edition so fine in every respect. He could not do much at once, but sends five receipts (росписки) of artists of the Warsaw Dramatic Theatre who have subscribed to the whole set of the Ежегодникъ and wish to receive the books.
why: reception abroad/Warsaw; first five subscribers

gist: Continuation: the subscribers take the books on easy terms; the sum due for all four Ежегодники with three supplements is spread over 14 months, because artists, and the Warsaw stage people especially, are meagrely paid compared with other theatres and burdened with families.
why: instalment terms for the full set (payment over 14 months)

gist: End of the letter: asks the Контора to forward the receipts to the Warsaw Theatre Administration so that it deducts monthly from the subscribers' salaries and remits to Petersburg; suggests the Контора also send him several copies of the latest season with three supplements to sell for cash, since many buyers want to see the goods first. Signed.
why: distribution mechanism: salary deduction, cash-sale stock

Asks at what price to sell: 3 р. 50 к. or 5 руб. per copy, warning 5 руб. will be harder. Encloses the subscription slip of opera artist г-жа Гроссъ. Left third is the overlapping p.37 sheet.

gist: Asked for his opinion of the latest Ежегодникъ, he refers to the enclosed newspaper clipping and adds that its compilation feels monotonous (однообразіе), though the three supplement books make up for it. Proposal: include in future Ежегодники a detailed report on the Warsaw theatres, which are government theatres on exactly the same footing as the Imperial ones (officials on crown terms, etc.).
key_names: Іосифъ Львовичъ Гологовскій? (Warsaw; surname doubtful, perhaps Гольговскій)

gist: Describes the Warsaw theatres to justify inclusion: three or four theatres play daily all year including Lent (except Christmas Eve and Holy Thursday-Saturday, both calendars); Italian and local Polish opera, a 'Большая балетная труппа' of just over 200 people, operetta, drama, and a separate farce/vaudeville troupe; repertoire more varied than the Imperial theatres'; concerts, masquerades, matinees, summer theatre. Margin note: some 25 years ago Warsaw had its own very good theatrical Ежегодникъ, without illustrations, which ceased on the death of its compiler. Left third is the overlapping p.37 sheet.
key_names: Іосифъ Львовичъ Гологовскій? (Warsaw; surname doubtful, perhaps Гольговскій)

key_names: Іосифъ Львовичъ Гологовскій? (Warsaw; surname doubtful, perhaps Гольговскій)
why: Closing courtesies only

from_to: Управленіе Варшавскихъ Правительственныхъ Театровъ -> С.-Петербургская Контора Императорскихъ Театровъ
gist: Further to the letters of 6 and 23 March 1895 (№№ 598/101 and 779/145), Warsaw remits 121 руб. 50 коп. due for ten sets of the Ежегодникъ subscribed by Warsaw theatre artists (list begins). Incoming № 2959; cashier's stamp (квитанція № 107934?); margin note that 121 р. 50 к. was received 30 Апр. 1896.
why: Payment of 121 р. 50 к. for ten subscriber sets, a year after delivery

from_to: Управленіе Варшавскихъ Правительственныхъ Театровъ -> С.-Петербургская Контора Императорскихъ Театровъ
gist: Second photo of p.60, lower down: the ten subscribers named — Ладновскій, Рапацкій, Ржечникъ?, Роландъ, Френкель, Лещинскій, Домбровская, Кулеша, чиновникъ Левицкій and электротехникъ Кондаковъ?. Margin notes: 'недополучено съ Домбровской 3 р. 50 к.'; 121 р. 50 к. entered in the Контора's general funds.
why: Named Warsaw subscribers and accounting notes on the remittance

from_to: Управленіе Варшавскихъ Правительственныхъ Театровъ -> С.-Петербургская Контора Императорскихъ Театровъ
gist: Third photo of the same page, lowest part: subscriber list and the line 'Недоимка въ количествѣ 3 р. 50 к.'; pencil/ink office notes at foot about entering the money (dated 1896, mostly unread).
why: Overlap of p.60-61; adds only the arrears line and faint office notes

from_to: Управленіе Варшавскихъ Правительственныхъ Театровъ -> С.-Петербургская Контора Императорскихъ Театровъ
gist: The 3 р. 50 к. arrears stand against opera artist Домбровская, now on leave without pay; it will be withheld on her return and sent to the Контора at once. Signed for the Chairman by a Дѣйствительный Статскій Совѣтникъ (signature unread).
why: Tail of the remittance letter: one subscriber's 3 р. 50 к. arrears

doc_type: duplicate view of another page (letter, end)
from_to: Управленіе Варшавскихъ Правительственныхъ Театровъ -> Контора Императорскихъ Театровъ (СПб)
gist: Overlapping photo of the lower half of p.63: close of the Warsaw theatre administration's covering letter. The unpaid remainder owed by the opera artist Домбровская (on leave without salary) will be withheld on her return and sent to the Контора. Signed 'за Предсѣдателя, Дѣйствительный Статскій Совѣтникъ' (signature unread) and Секретарь.
why: Subscription arrears for Yearbook copies sold to Warsaw artists; no sum on this view (the sum is on p.63).

date: Варшава 17/29 Апр. 1896 (receipt note: Получ. 20 апр. 96 г.)
from_to: Іосифъ Львовичъ Гологовскій -> Центральная Библіотека Императорскихъ Театровъ
gist: Start of Gologovsky's letter: last summer he wrote several letters to г. Петровъ (Константинъ Андреевичъ) about the «Театральный Ежегодникъ» he orders for Warsaw theatre artists and got no reply, so he now writes to the Central Library directly. His Warsaw address is written in the margin (street name not read with confidence). Right edge shows part of the facing leaf.
why: Shows the Central Library/Petrov as the Yearbook's distribution office and an unanswered agent's correspondence.

gist: Continuation of p.65: at his intervention the Warsaw Theatre Administration today sent the Контора of the St Petersburg Imperial Theatres 121 руб. 50 коп. withheld from artists' salaries for 10 copies of the «Ежегодникъ»; 3 р. 50 к. remains unwithheld from the opera singer Домбровская, on six months' unpaid leave, and will follow.
why: Money figures: 121 р. 50 к. remitted for 10 subscription sets, paid by salary deduction.

gist: Continuation: he stresses that when he asked the 'библіотека' to send 10 more complete sets to place among the artists, the post brought a bale of 10 copies each of the 1st, 2nd and 3rd приложенія but none of the Yearbooks themselves 'за весь 4 годъ'; he could not offer supplements without the Yearbook, they lie with him intact. 'Что съ ними дѣлать?' Edges show neighbouring leaves.
why: Dispatch error by the Central Library: supplements of the 4th issue sent without the main volume; stock sitting unsold in Warsaw.

gist: Continuation: asks the Central Library to send him one copy of the just-published fifth Ежегодникъ with all 3 приложенія on condition: if the same 10 artists want it on the former terms he will at once order 10 copies of the 5th year and keep the one sent as his own (the '11th copy'); otherwise its price is to be deducted from his salary (continued in the margin, with his signature and office).
key_names: Іосифъ Львовичъ Гологовскій (чиновникъ Управленія Варшавскихъ Правительственныхъ Театровъ)
why: Terms of the agent arrangement: a free 11th copy for every 10 subscribers; 5th issue just out.

gist: Overlapping photo of the lower two-thirds of p.68 (same text about one copy of the 5th Ежегодникъ and the 11th-copy condition); the last line adds 'Въ противномъ случаѣ причитающіеся за этотъ экземпляръ…'. Nothing new otherwise.
why: Duplicate/overlap of p.68.

gist: Opening of an earlier letter (signature and date on pp.74-75: Варшава 10/22 Іюля 1894): he begs His Excellency to order that one copy [of each Yearbook] be sent to him cash-on-delivery through the Administration of the Warsaw Government Theatres. Registry mark 'Ц. Б. №' at top left (number doubtful).
why: First approach of the future Warsaw agent, addressed to Pogozhev as the Yearbook's publisher.

gist: Overlapping photo of the lower part of p.70 (same request to Владиміръ Петровичъ). At the bottom a strip of a different leaf shows through: '…безплатный экземпляръ полнаго комплекта, кромѣ 3-ей книги приложеній' (from the list on pp.76-77).
why: Duplicate/overlap of p.70.

gist: Office note: 1 copy of the 2nd issue and 1 copy of the 3rd issue of the Ежегодникъ Имп. Театровъ sent cash-on-delivery (8 руб.) to Warsaw to Іосифъ Львовичъ Гологовскій; dated 14 Іюля 1894, with a signature (not read).
why: Dispatch record with price: 8 руб. C.O.D. for issues 2 and 3.

from_to: Варшавская Почтовая Контора (5 экспедиція) -> Контора Императорскихъ театровъ, СПб
gist: Post-office notice (Извѣщеніе) № 1174 forwarding 8 руб., the C.O.D. charge on a parcel addressed to Іосифъ Гологовскій: posted in St Petersburg 15 Іюля, received in Warsaw 17 Іюля, paid by the addressee 20 Іюля. Left margin has a pencil word, probably 'Ежегодникъ'.
why: Proof of payment (8 руб.) for the copies on p.72; routine postal paperwork.

gist: Continuation of the letter begun on p.70: he wants the «Ежегодникъ Императорскихъ Театровъ» 'издаваемаго Вашимъ Превосходительствомъ', all issues so far published except the first year, which he bought himself during some three years' stay in St Petersburg. Closing compliments begin.
why: A provincial official calls Pogozhev the publisher of the Yearbook and orders the back issues.

gist: Overlapping photo of the lower part of p.74 with the end of the letter: signature Гологовскій, date and 'Мой адресъ: Іосифъ Львовичъ Гологовскій, Чинов. Управл. Варш. Прав. Т-ровъ'. A strip of another leaf shows at the bottom (same line as on p.71).
key_names: Іосифъ Львовичъ Гологовскій (чиновникъ Управленія Варшавскихъ Правительственныхъ Театровъ)
why: Gives the date and sender of the letter on pp.70 and 74; otherwise overlap.

date: annotation '24/26 IV' [the fair copy on p.80 is dated 24 Апрѣля]; registry notes '12 р. 50 к. — 29 сент. 94 Вход. № 3798', '13 окт. 94'
from_to: Дирекція Императорскихъ Театровъ, Ц. Б. [Петровъ] -> Гологовскій
gist: Draft ('Отпускъ') of the Central Library's letter: in the summer he sent figures of Yearbook copies dispatched to Warsaw and asked whether they agree with Warsaw's; the need to present an account (отчетъ) forces him to ask again to clear up the muddle, caused probably by dealing at once with Gologovsky personally and with the Administration. A table by issue (I, II, III, IV, приложенія 1-3) begins.
why: The Central Library reconciling its Yearbook dispatch account; start of an itemised table of copies sent.

gist: Draft table of copies sent to Warsaw, by issue: (1) one free copy of issue IV sent on the order of В. П. Погожевъ after Gologovsky's letter of 10/22 февраля; (2) five subscribers Ладновскій, Рапацкій, Р…(?), Роландъ(?), Френкель — 5 of each; (3) five subscribers Домбровская, Лещинскій, Кулешъ(?), Левицъ(?), Кондаковъ(?) — 5 of each; (4) one free 'льготный' copy to Gologovsky for bringing 10 subscribers; (5) a free complete set to the Управляющій of the Warsaw Government Theatres (continues).
why: Named Warsaw artist-subscribers, free copies and the reward copy for an agent, itemised per issue.

gist: Table continued: (5) the Administration's free copy was wrongly taken by Gologovsky as a subscription one (his letter of 3/15 мая); (6) subscriber г-жа Грассъ, whose copy he took over when she left; (7) on commission for sale — 10 each of the three приложенія of issue IV. Totals 13/13/13 for issues I-III, 14 (corrected from 19) for IV, 24/24/24(23?) for the supplements. Summary: eleven complete sets for subscribers at 12 р. 50 к. = 137 р. 50 к.; commission copies at 5 р.; two free sets and one free copy of IV. He asks how many copies of each issue were received and when.
why: Prices and totals: complete set of four issues 12 р. 50 к. to subscribers, 137 р. 50 к. due; copies on commission at 5 р.

gist: Overlapping photo of the foot of p.78 plus the end of the draft: questions (2) what sum has been withheld from subscribers and when it will be sent, (3) whether the copies of the 4th issue sent for sale have been sold and how many, with a request to return unsold ones — these paragraphs are crossed out. Pencil sums at the bottom right (125…, 137-50).
why: Questions on sums collected and unsold commission copies (struck from the final letter).

from_to: К. А. Петровъ (Завѣдывающій Центральною Библіотекою Императорскихъ Театровъ) -> Іосифъ Львовичъ [Гологовскій]
gist: 'Копія' on the printed letterhead of the Head of the Central Library: he sent figures in the summer and has had no reply; the account must be presented. The muddle arose partly 'по нашей винѣ', since of the 4th issue only the books of «приложеній» were sent, but mainly from dealing with both Gologovsky and the Administration. A list of what was sent is overleaf.
why: The Central Library admits its own dispatch error and explains how Yearbook distribution to Warsaw was handled.

gist: Overlapping photo of the lower part of p.80 with the end of the paragraph: he asks to be told what of the listed copies was not received by Gologovsky and by the Administration; then, after making enquiries, he can sort the matter out.
why: Mostly overlap of p.80; adds only the closing request.

gist: Fair copy of the table 'Выслано / Выпуски' (I, II, III; Вып. IV: приложенія 1, 2, 3 and the Ежегодникъ itself): (1) free copy of IV by order of В. П. Погожевъ after the letter of 10/22 февраля 1895; (2) Ладновскій, Рапацкій, Р…(?), Роландъ(?), Френкель — 5; (3) г-жа Домбровская, Лещинскій, Кулешъ(?), Левицъ(?), Кондаковъ(?) — 5; (4) Gologovsky's free copy for delivering 10 subscribers; (5) free copy of all issues to the Управляющій of the Warsaw theatres, mistaken for a subscription copy; (6) г-жа Грассъ (cut off).
why: Cleanest version of the per-issue distribution table with named subscribers and free copies.

gist: Overlapping photo of the lower part of the table on p.82, complete to the end: (6) г-жа Грассъ's copy taken over by Gologovsky; (7) on commission for sale — 10 each of the three приложенія ('книги самого «Ежегодника» ошибочно не были высланы'). Всего: 13, 13, 13 (issues I-III); 24, 24, 24 (приложенія of IV); 14 (Ежегодникъ IV).
why: Final totals of copies sent to Warsaw and the admitted error with the commission copies.

gist: Copy continued: Gologovsky's letter of 17/29 Апрѣля arrived before this was finished. He will shortly receive 10 copies of the Ежегодникъ of issue IV itself to complete the 10 sets sent for sale. 121 р. 50 к. received; Warsaw still owes 7 руб. (3 р. 50 к. Домбровская, 3 р. 50 к. for the Грассъ copy). Subscription to issue V is closed since it is out; its sale price is 5 рублей, but when subscription to issue VI opens subscribers may get V at the reduced price of 4 р. 50 к. Issue I = season 1890-91, II = 1891-92, III = 1892-93, IV = 1893-94; issue IV has three books of «Приложеній», the first three had none.
why: Prices (5 р. retail, 4 р. 50 к. to subscribers), the subscription mechanism, and the issue-to-season key with the note on supplements.

gist: Overlapping photo of the lower part of p.84 (price of issue V, issue/season key, three books of Приложеній); last lines add that he will make enquiries about the subscription copy of Карандѣевъ.
why: Overlap of p.84 with two further lines.

gist: End of the copy: '[Карандѣевъ]… въ подписчикахъ не значится. Буду ждать Вашего отвѣта. /Подписалъ/ Готовый къ услугамъ К. Петровъ.' Rest of the page blank.
why: Only the close and Petrov's signature — confirms him as author of the Central Library letter.

gist: Start of Gologovsky's long reply. §1: he cannot recall whether he received Petrov's letter of last year; alarmed at receiving only «приложеній» in 10 copies (30 books) without the four «Ежегодниковъ» (40 books), he wrote several times for an explanation, got none and waited a whole year, meanwhile seeing that the sums due from the theatre subscribers were duly withheld and the collected 121 руб. 50 коп. sent to the Контора. He will see to the 3 р. 50 shortfall from the singer Домбровская when her long leave ends.
why: Agent's account of a year of unanswered letters to Petrov and of how subscription money was collected.

gist: Overlapping photo of the lower part of p.87 (same §1 text, complete to the foot of the page).
why: Duplicate/overlap of p.87.

gist: §2, answering the list point by point: (1) the copy of issue IV kindly granted free by В. П. Погожевъ, as to one who had ordered the first three Yearbooks and paid 12 руб. 50 коп. — received with thanks; (2,3) all 4 Yearbooks with 3 приложенія for the 10 artist-subscribers received and handed over, money deducted and sent, bar Домбровская's 3 р. 50 к.; (4) the eleventh, 'льготный' copy due to him for his trouble — received; (5) the copy for the late Chairman of the Warsaw theatres, генералъ Карандѣевъ, was handed over through the Secretary; (6) the operetta artist г-жа Грассъ ordered a copy, then abruptly left the stage and went abroad; he kept it hoping to resell it and will have 1 руб. a month deducted from his salary (12 р. 50 к. in all).
why: Recipient-side confirmation of every free and paid copy, with the 12 р. 50 к. set price and payment by monthly salary deduction.

gist: Overlapping photo of the lower part of p.89 (points 5 and 6, complete to the foot: the Грассъ copy, payment of 12 р. 50 коп. at 1 руб. a month).
why: Duplicate/overlap of p.89.

gist: He begs Константинъ Андреевичъ not to send the 10 copies of issue IV (now too late) but to expect the return of the 10 copies of all three приложенія (30 books), and instead, if he sees fit, to send issue V with its 3 приложенія for the 10 former artist-subscribers on the former favourable terms (even at 5 руб. a copy) plus an eleventh copy free for himself; failing that, one copy of issue V for himself for five roubles, deducted at 1 руб. a month through the cashier.
why: Return of 30 unsold supplement volumes; proposed order of issue V at 5 руб. with a free agent's copy.

gist: Overlapping photo of the lower part of p.91, continuing: he does not understand Petrov's unfinished sentence giving the issue/season key (I = 1890-91 … IV = 1893-94). As for the subscription copy for Генер. Карандѣевъ, no need to worry any more: 'Онъ тамъ на небѣ вѣроятно' (continues on p.93).
why: Partly overlap, but carries the lead-in to the ballet remark on p.93 and the reader's puzzlement at the issue/season key.

gist: Continuation: [the late General Карандѣевъ is probably up in heaven] 'репетируетъ балетъ съ херувимчиками и небесными феями' — a tribute to a kind man who loved art to self-forgetfulness and whose tireless work brought him young to the grave. He apologises for the long letter, written at Petrov's own wish to explain everything exactly, and hopes for a reply. Closing formula; signature begins.
why: Ballet mentioned, though only as a figure of speech about the dead chairman of the Warsaw theatres; no ballet work, composer or dancer named.

gist: Overlapping photo of the lower part of p.93: end of the letter, signature Іосифъ Гологовскій, and the date and place.
why: Supplies the date and signature of the letter on pp.87-93; otherwise overlap.
